source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, perfectly flat surface filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: the smooth bark of a giant emergent tree (Koompassia excelsa, tualang): pale pinkish-grey to silver-grey, very smooth and almost polished, with faint vertical streaks, scattered small round lenticels, a few thin horizontal ring creases, patches of pale lichen and faint greenish algae stains, no furrows or plates. Keep colours natural but slightly muted and even, so the texture can be tinted to different palettes without looking stained.
source.reuse: the hyperjungle's comb tree bole (biomes/hyperjungle station savage, to wire); any smooth pale emergent: tualang, kapok, the bee trees
